# NT51928 CtrlRAM Replace Handoff

NT51928 non-NB follows the NT51927 postbuild family. NT51928 NB is explicitly
not covered, and no additional owner files are requested. The canonical alias
references only NT51927's two-chip input evidence for physical role, slot/order,
and ten-command postbuild facts. It does not alias reference or output bytes:
NT51928 retains its distinct 512 KiB base, PID `0xF206`, profile, exact-route
parity, and DP/LDC tail-preservation evidence. No support promotion is implied.
